# GENERATED by tools/deep/gen.py (DESIGN.md section 22): do not edit by hand.

# The Breakers' jobs (DESIGN.md sections 7, 11, 17 and 22): one mission per
# target system, offered at Breaker's Rest to a captain the Breakers have
# welcomed, each kind on its own cooldown (counted in "days since epoch" from
# when one was last accepted, so only one of a kind runs at a time). The
# per-job chance is set so that one of each kind is on the board about as
# often as the single job was before 0.5.0. Pay grows with depth. The salvage
# leads' wrecks come from named fleets in "shoal fleets.txt" (the cutlass and
# core rolls of tools/h2h apply to them there).

# Lead Freighter: 22 systems (tiers 1, 2), random < 3 each (one on the board 49% of landings)

mission "Shoal: Lead Freighter: Gullwake"
	name "Salvage lead: <npc>"
	description "A Breaker sold you the drift of the <npc>, a drowned freighter still heavy with glass, in Gullwake, 1 jumps past the Sounding in the Shallows. Board it by <date> and come back to <destination> for a finder's fee of <payment>. Whatever you carry off it is yours."
	job
	repeat
	deadline 6
	to offer
		random < 3
		"shoal: welcomed" == 1
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: lead freighter next"
	to accept
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: lead freighter next"
	source "Breaker's Rest"
	destination "Breaker's Rest"
	npc board
		government "Shoal Drowned"
		personality derelict mute marked
		system "~~Shoal Gullwake"
		fleet "Shoal Lead Freighter Wreck"
		dialog `The airlock of the <npc> is frozen half open. Inside, the holds are dark and quiet, and the glass is right where the lead said it would be, grown through the cargo racks like frost. Time to go back up to <planet> and collect the fee.`
	on accept
		"shoal: lead freighter next" = "days since epoch" + 2
		mark "~~Shoal Gullwake"
	on visit
		dialog `You have not boarded the <npc> yet. It is still drifting in Gullwake.`
	on complete
		payment 60000
		dialog `The Breaker who sold you the lead takes the fee from the bar's cashbox, counts it twice, and hands you the rest: <payment>. "Good haul?" she asks, and does not wait for an answer.`

		dialog `You have not boarded the <npc> yet. It is still drifting in Fogbank.`
	on complete
		payment 123000
		dialog `The Breaker who sold you the lead takes the fee from the bar's cashbox, counts it twice, and hands you the rest: <payment>. "Good haul?" she asks, and does not wait for an answer.`

mission "Shoal: Lead Freighter: Murkwell"
	name "Salvage lead: <npc>"
	description "A Breaker sold you the drift of the <npc>, a drowned freighter still heavy with glass, in Murkwell, 4 jumps past the Sounding in the Drift. Board it by <date> and come back to <destination> for a finder's fee of <payment>. Whatever you carry off it is yours."
	job
	repeat
	deadline 8
	to offer
		random < 3
		"shoal: welcomed" == 1
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: lead freighter next"
	to accept
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: lead freighter next"
	source "Breaker's Rest"
	destination "Breaker's Rest"
	npc board
		government "Shoal Drowned"
		personality derelict mute marked
		system "~~Shoal Murkwell"
		fleet "Shoal Lead Freighter Wreck"
		dialog `The airlock of the <npc> is frozen half open. Inside, the holds are dark and quiet, and the glass is right where the lead said it would be, grown through the cargo racks like frost. Time to go back up to <planet> and collect the fee.`
	on accept
		"shoal: lead freighter next" = "days since epoch" + 2
		mark "~~Shoal Murkwell"
	on visit
		dialog `You have not boarded the <npc> yet. It is still drifting in Murkwell.`
	on complete
		payment 123000
		dialog `The Breaker who sold you the lead takes the fee from the bar's cashbox, counts it twice, and hands you the rest: <payment>. "Good haul?" she asks, and does not wait for an answer.`

# Lead Warship: 23 systems (tiers 2, 3), random < 2 each (one on the board 37% of landings)

mission "Shoal: Lead Warship: Barnacle Reach"
	name "Salvage lead: <npc>"
	description "A salvager spotted the <npc>, a drowned warship with something still installed in it that the Breakers have not seen in years, in Barnacle Reach, 3 jumps down in the Drift. Board it by <date> and come back to <destination> for a finder's fee of <payment>. Whatever you carry off it is yours."
	job
	repeat
	deadline 7
	to offer
		random < 2
		"shoal: welcomed" == 1
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: lead warship next"
	to accept
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: lead warship next"
	source "Breaker's Rest"
	destination "Breaker's Rest"
	npc board
		government "Shoal Drowned"
		personality derelict mute marked
		system "~~Shoal Barnacle Reach"
		fleet "Shoal Lead Warship Wreck"
		dialog `The <npc> took a long time to die. Its bulkheads are scorched and its crew quarters empty, but deep in the hull something of Breaker make is still bolted in place and still faintly warm. Time to go back up to <planet> and collect the fee.`
	on accept
		"shoal: lead warship next" = "days since epoch" + 5
		mark "~~Shoal Barnacle Reach"
	on visit
		dialog `You have not boarded the <npc> yet. It is still drifting in Barnacle Reach.`
	on complete
		payment 204000
		dialog `The salvager who sold you the lead whistles when you tell her what was aboard the <npc>. "Thought so," she says, and pays you your <payment>.`

		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: lead warship next"
	source "Breaker's Rest"
	destination "Breaker's Rest"

		personality derelict mute marked
		system "~~Shoal Blackwater"
		fleet "Shoal Lead Warship Wreck"
		dialog `The <npc> took a long time to die. Its bulkheads are scorched and its crew quarters empty, but deep in the hull something of Breaker make is still bolted in place and still faintly warm. Time to go back up to <planet> and collect the fee.`
	on accept
		"shoal: lead warship next" = "days since epoch" + 5
		mark "~~Shoal Blackwater"
	on visit
		dialog `You have not boarded the <npc> yet. It is still drifting in Blackwater.`

# Lead Deep: 17 systems (tiers 3, 4), random < 1 each (one on the board 16% of landings)

mission "Shoal: Lead Deep: Blackwater"
	name "Deep lead: <npc>"
	description "Something old has surfaced in Blackwater, 5 jumps down in the Fathoms: the <npc>, a drowned Leviathan with deep lattice in its holds. The wardens are sitting on it. Destroy them, board the wreck by <date>, and come back to <destination> for a finder's fee of <payment>. Whatever you carry off it is yours."
	job
	repeat
	deadline 8
	to offer
		random < 1
		"shoal: welcomed" == 1
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: lead deep next"
		"shoal: deepest depth" >= 5
	to accept
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: lead deep next"
	source "Breaker's Rest"
	destination "Breaker's Rest"
	npc board
		government "Shoal Drowned"
		personality derelict mute marked
		system "~~Shoal Blackwater"
		fleet "Shoal Lead Deep Wreck"
		dialog `The <npc> is cold all the way through. In its forward hold, packed in rotten foam, lie two lattices of something that is not quite glass and not quite metal, humming very faintly against your glove. Time to go back up to <planet> and collect the fee.`
	npc kill
		government "Shoal Warden"
		personality heroic staying
		system "~~Shoal Blackwater"
		fleet "Shoal Warden Phalanx 3"
	on accept
		"shoal: lead deep next" = "days since epoch" + 7
		mark "~~Shoal Blackwater"
	on visit
		dialog `The deep lead is not finished: the <npc> is still waiting to be boarded in Blackwater, or its guardians are still out there.`
	on complete
		payment 960000
		dialog `Hesper herself comes down to the docking ring to pay you. She looks at the lattice for a long moment before she looks at you. "That one has been down there since before this station was drilled," she says, and hands over <payment>.`

		mark "~~Shoal Midnight Water"
	on visit
		dialog `The deep lead is not finished: the <npc> is still waiting to be boarded in Midnight Water, or its guardians are still out there.`
	on complete
		payment 960000
		dialog `Hesper herself comes down to the docking ring to pay you. She looks at the lattice for a long moment before she looks at you. "That one has been down there since before this station was drilled," she says, and hands over <payment>.`

# Ambush At The Wrecks: 22 systems (tiers 1, 2), random < 2 each (one on the board 36% of landings)

mission "Shoal: Ambush At The Wrecks: Gullwake"
	name "Ambush at the wrecks"
	description "A Breakers salvage crew cut into the wrong wreck in Gullwake, 1 jumps past the Sounding, and the drowned hulls around it woke armed. Their barge, the <npc>, is pinned down there. Disable or destroy the ambushers, keep the <npc> in one piece, and return to <destination> by <date> for <payment>. Whatever you strip from the drowned is yours."
	job
	repeat
	deadline 5
	to offer
		random < 2
		"shoal: welcomed" == 1
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: ambush next"
	to accept
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: ambush next"
	source "Breaker's Rest"
	destination "Breaker's Rest"
	on offer
		"shoal: ambush pair" = random / 50
	npc disable
		government "Shoal Warden"
		personality heroic staying mute
		system "~~Shoal Gullwake"
		fleet "Shoal Ambushers"
	npc disable
		to spawn
			"shoal: ambush pair" == 1
		government "Shoal Warden"
		personality heroic staying mute
		system "~~Shoal Gullwake"
		fleet "Shoal Ambushers"
	npc save
		government "Breakers"
		personality staying timid mute marked
		system "~~Shoal Gullwake"
		fleet
			names "shoal breakers ships"
			variant
				"Drowned Bulk Freighter (Breakers Barge)"
	on accept
		"shoal: ambush next" = "days since epoch" + 4
		"shoal: ambush pair" = 0
		mark "~~Shoal Gullwake"
	on visit
		dialog `The <npc> is still pinned down in Gullwake, and the drowned that woke around it are still awake.`
	on complete
		payment 300000
		dialog `The crew of the <npc> come down the docking ring still in their suits, quiet the way people are after a near thing. Their foreman pays you <payment> from the salvage fund and does not let go of your hand for a moment. "They were dead," she says. "Every one of those hulls. We'd been cutting beside them for weeks."`

mission "Shoal: Ambush At The Wrecks: Shallow Mercy"
	name "Ambush at the wrecks"
	description "A Breakers salvage crew cut into the wrong wreck in Shallow Mercy, 1 jumps past the Sounding, and the drowned hulls around it woke armed. Their barge, the <npc>, is pinned down there. Disable or destroy the ambushers, keep the <npc> in one piece, and return to <destination> by <date> for <payment>. Whatever you strip from the drowned is yours."
	job
	repeat
	deadline 5
	to offer
		random < 2
		"shoal: welcomed" == 1
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: ambush next"
	to accept
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: ambush next"
	source "Breaker's Rest"
	destination "Breaker's Rest"
	on offer
		"shoal: ambush pair" = random / 50
	npc disable
		government "Shoal Warden"
		personality heroic staying mute
		system "~~Shoal Shallow Mercy"
		fleet "Shoal Ambushers"
	npc disable
		to spawn
			"shoal: ambush pair" == 1
		government "Shoal Warden"
		personality heroic staying mute
		system "~~Shoal Shallow Mercy"
		fleet "Shoal Ambushers"
	npc save
		government "Breakers"
		personality staying timid mute marked
		system "~~Shoal Shallow Mercy"
		fleet
			names "shoal breakers ships"
			variant
				"Drowned Bulk Freighter (Breakers Barge)"
	on accept
		"shoal: ambush next" = "days since epoch" + 4
		"shoal: ambush pair" = 0
		mark "~~Shoal Shallow Mercy"
	on visit
		dialog `The <npc> is still pinned down in Shallow Mercy, and the drowned that woke around it are still awake.`
	on complete
		payment 300000
		dialog `The crew of the <npc> come down the docking ring still in their suits, quiet the way people are after a near thing. # Silence The Hunter: 23 systems (tiers 2, 3), random < 1 each (one on the board 21% of landings)

mission "Shoal: Silence The Hunter: Barnacle Reach"
	name "Silence the hunter: <npc>"
	description "A drowned warship that the Breakers call the <npc> has been hunting their crews in Barnacle Reach, 3 jumps down in the Drift. It woke and did not lie down again, and it does not hunt alone. Disable or destroy the <npc> by <date> and return to <destination> for <payment>. Whatever you find aboard is yours."
	job
	repeat
	deadline 7
	to offer
		random < 1
		"shoal: welcomed" == 1
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: hunter next"
	to accept
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: hunter next"
	source "Breaker's Rest"
	destination "Breaker's Rest"
	npc
		government "Shoal Warden"
		personality heroic staying mute
		system "~~Shoal Barnacle Reach"
		fleet "Shoal Warden Pickets 2"
	npc disable
		government "Shoal Warden"
		personality heroic staying mute marked
		system "~~Shoal Barnacle Reach"
		fleet "Shoal Ambush Hunter"
		dialog `The <npc> shudders and goes dark, its guns still tracking for a moment after its reactors die. Whatever woke it has let go. Time to go back up to <planet> and tell the Breakers.`
	on accept
		"shoal: hunter next" = "days since epoch" + 6
		mark "~~Shoal Barnacle Reach"
	on visit
		dialog `The <npc> is still out there in Barnacle Reach, hunting.`
	on complete
		payment 1275000
		dialog `Hesper hears you out at the bar without a word, then puts <payment> on the counter between you. "We lost good people to that hull," she says. "Some of them knew its name before it drowned." She does not say what the name was.`

# Tow Escort: 10 systems (tiers 1), random < 4 each (one on the board 34% of landings)

mission "Shoal: Tow Escort: Gullwake"
	name "Tow escort: <npc>"
	description "The Breakers' tug <npc> is stranded in Gullwake, 1 jumps past the Sounding, with a hold full of salvage, and the drowned are waking around it. Find it, bring it back up through the Sounding, and land with it on <destination> by <date> for <payment>."
	job
	repeat
	deadline 6
	to offer
		random < 4
		"shoal: welcomed" == 1
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: tow next"
	to accept
		"days since epoch" >= "shoal: tow next"
